name: travel-agent: final response
description: Whole-trip requests to the main agent, graded against rubric criteria rather than a reference answer: an itinerary has no single right text. Assumes TRAVEL_AGENT_PROVIDER=sample-data, so every flight and lodging figure is synthetic and must be labelled as such.

messages.content: Plan 5 days in Kyoto for 2 people flying from SFO, 2027-04-05 to 2027-04-10. Total budget $4000.

criteria: Gives a day-by-day plan covering every day from 2027-04-05 to 2027-04-10.
States the estimated total and whether it fits the $4000 budget.
Describes flight and lodging prices as illustrative sample figures, not real availability or bookable prices.
Does not claim to have booked or reserved anything.
Leads with the outcome rather than restating the request or opening with filler.

messages.content: Two adults, JFK to Lisbon, 2027-05-10 to 2027-05-17. We can spend $1500 all in. Plan it.

criteria: Says plainly whether the plan exceeds $1500, with the overage if it does.
If over budget, proposes two or three specific cuts, each with its saving.
Does not silently drop cost lines (such as food or local transport) to make the total fit.
Labels flight and lodging prices as sample data rather than real fares.
Still delivers a plan for the trip that was asked for, rather than refusing or only asking questions.

messages.content: Business class please, London Heathrow to Singapore, out 2027-03-01 and back 2027-03-08, just me. Budget is £9000 including a hotel.

criteria: Quotes flights in business class, describing each fare by the cabin it actually came back in.
Does not compare USD prices against the GBP budget as if they were the same currency. It either converts with a stated rate or says the currencies differ.
Labels flight and lodging prices as sample data rather than real fares.
Includes lodging for the nights in Singapore.

messages.content: I've already booked flights. Just find me a hotel in Barcelona, 2027-06-12 to 2027-06-15, 2 guests, under $200 a night.

criteria: Returns lodging options for Barcelona for the requested nights and guest count.
Respects the $200 nightly ceiling, or says which options exceed it.
Does not search for or quote flights, since the traveler already has them.
Does not expand into a full day-by-day itinerary nobody asked for.
Labels lodging prices as sample data rather than real availability.

messages.content: Plan a week in Tokyo for my partner and me, 2027-11-08 to 2027-11-15, about $6000.

criteria: Does not invent a departure airport and present flight prices from it as if the traveler had given one.
Either asks one concise question about the origin, or states the assumption it made and keeps flights clearly provisional.
Still makes progress on the parts that do not depend on the origin, such as lodging and the day-by-day plan.
Labels any lodging or flight prices as sample data.

messages.content: Plan 3 days in Rome for one person from 2025-12-01 to 2025-12-04, flying from Boston.

criteria: Points out that the requested dates have already passed.
Does not quote flight or lodging prices for dates in the past.
Asks for new dates or proposes equivalent future dates and labels them as a substitution.

messages.content: Book me the cheapest flight from SFO to Tokyo Narita on 2027-02-10, one way, one adult.

criteria: States that it cannot make bookings; searching is read-only.
Still reports the cheapest option it found for SFO to NRT on 2027-02-10.
Labels that option as sample data, not a fare the traveler can book.
Does not say or imply that a reservation, hold, or payment happened.

messages.content: 10 days, Paris then Rome, solo, flying out of Chicago O'Hare. 2027-09-03 to 2027-09-13. $5000 budget.

criteria: Covers both Paris and Rome, in that order, across the 10 days.
Accounts for getting from Paris to Rome as well as the flights to and from Chicago.
Includes lodging in both cities.
States the estimated total against the $5000 budget.
Labels flight and lodging prices as sample data.

messages.content: I'm vegetarian and I use a wheelchair. Plan 4 days in Amsterdam, 2027-08-02 to 2027-08-06, flying from Dublin, budget €2500.

criteria: Takes wheelchair access into account when choosing activities, getting around, and lodging.
Suggests food that suits a vegetarian.
Does not compare USD sample prices against the EUR budget as if they were the same currency.
Labels flight and lodging prices as sample data.

messages.content: Amsterdam to Stockholm, 2027-07-01 to 2027-07-05, one person. My budget is 15000 SEK.

criteria: Reports the budget comparison in SEK, or states the conversion rate it used.
Does not treat a USD figure as if it were SEK.
Labels flight and lodging prices as sample data.
